headline: Brazil Supreme Court holds up privatization of state data firm Celepar
summary: Brazil's Supreme Court is voting on whether to maintain a stay on Paraná's sale of Celepar, the state company holding public tax and health records.
why: Celepar is a state-owned information technology firm in Paraná, Brazil.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Court decisions block state-level privatization plans for asset sales.
